wARS.$comment:
wARS ('Peso Argentino') on Arc. THE ARS FEED IS INVERTED AND MUST NOT BE REGISTERED AS type 'Chainlink'. Arc's only ARS feed is 0xa261C56CABf7Ed6081646b892E57175AB2Dd8617, and description() == 'USD / ARS' — measured on-chain 2026-09-17, 8 decimals, answer 159640110000 = 1596.4011 ARS per USD, updatedAt 2026-09-16T20:50:32Z. That is the RECIPROCAL of the asset/USD direction every primary feed uses. Registering it directly would price the KPK wARS Yield vault's 9,000 wARS at $14,367,609.90 instead of $5.64 — an over-report of 2,548,496x (the square of the rate). Nothing in the config schema encodes feed direction, so no existing guard catches it; the rateFeedGuard below is what catches it.

This mirrors the LIVE chain-1 registration exactly (same contract, same band, same guard, same wARS token address — wARS is 0x0DC4F92879B7670e5f4e4e6e3c801D229129D90D on BOTH chains, verified on Arc 2026-09-17: name() 'Peso Argentino', symbol() 'wARS', 18 decimals, codesize 163 minimal proxy, totalSupply 88,100,095e18). wARS is a plain ERC-20 with no wrapper/rate surface — convertToAssets, getRate and underlying all REVERT on Arc — so it prices off the inverted currency feed directly, with no CrossRate hop.

InvertedChainlinkCustomPriceFeed computes 1e8 * 10^feedDec / answer, keeping the division LAST. The param is named *ChainlinkAddress so RateFeedGuard._isRateFeedParam recognises it and the guard is MANDATORY rather than silently skipped. baseAsset 0x0 is an ASSERTION, not an omission: this feed reads no base/USD from the NAV, and PriceFeedLib._validateFeedNotCircular probes BASE_ASSET() by raw staticcall and FAILS CLOSED on a feed that cannot answer, so the contract implements INavSourcedPriceFeed and returns address(0). The deploy helper does not pass baseAsset to the constructor; it exists so the feed stays inside preflight's circularity checks.

HEARTBEAT 86400 = EXACTLY what Chainlink declares for this feed on Arc (reference-data-directory feeds-arc-mainnet.json), per ADR 0025's equality rule. NOTE THE MARGIN IS THIN AND THIS IS NOT A GUESS: sampled 2026-09-17 the feed was 17.76 h stale against a 24 h heartbeat. On chain 1 the equivalent pair was MEASURED over 13.2 days and 8 of 30 gaps exceeded 86400 s. Arc is days old so no comparable history exists yet; if this feed starts reporting stale, the answer is a RealignHeartbeats run against a re-declared value, NOT a hand-widened number.

rateFeedGuard.$comment: Pins BOTH the pair and the DIRECTION, identical to chain 1. description() == 'USD / ARS' catches a swap to any other pair; the band catches an inverted feed even if a description were forged — an ARS/USD feed would answer ~0.00063 (6.3e14 at 1e18 scale), five orders below the floor. The band is deliberately wide UPWARD because ARS is high-inflation and this rate only rises: 1596 today, ceiling 100000 allows ~63x further depreciation. THE FLOOR'S REAL TRIGGER IS REDENOMINATION, NOT APPRECIATION. Argentina has dropped 13 zeros across five redenominations; a 1,000:1 step takes 1596 -> 1.596, far below the floor, and the floor firing there is CORRECT — an ERC-20 wrapper cannot redenominate without a token migration, so a feed with no floor would keep valuing each un-redenominated wARS at ~1,000x its true worth. THE CORRECT RESPONSE IS A TOKEN/FEED MIGRATION REVIEW — NEVER widen the floor downward.

wARS.$noNavDependencyReason: This feed reads NO base/USD price out of the NAV. It derives wARS/USD wholly from ONE Chainlink leg by inverting it (1e8 * 10^feedDec / answer, division last), so there is no base asset to read and BASE_ASSET is a compile-time constant address(0) on InvertedChainlinkCustomPriceFeed, not a configurable argument. The zero here MIRRORS that constant so the feed stays inside preflight's circularity checks rather than being skipped by them: PriceFeedLib._validateFeedNotCircular probes BASE_ASSET() by raw staticcall and FAILS CLOSED (CustomFeedBaseUnreadable) on a feed that cannot answer, so the contract implements INavSourcedPriceFeed and returns address(0) deliberately. Because there is no NAV-sourced leg, the ADR 0019 base-must-be-DIRECTLY-priced invariant does not apply to this feed at all — the only freshness surface is the single Chainlink leg, whose heartbeat is pinned in the constructor and whose pair AND direction are pinned by the rateFeedGuard below.
